## Checklist

- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and task-relevant documentation.
- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Available builds/checks and relevant manual scenarios have exact recorded outcomes.
- [ ] New/changed behavior has regression coverage or an explicit testing gap.
- [ ] Accessibility, localization/RTL, privacy/security, and platform compatibility were considered.
- [ ] README, architecture, development, privacy/security, roadmap/release, and changelog docs are synchronized as applicable.
- [ ] Binary/archive/config/log/credential/personal-path artifacts are absent.
- [ ] Claims are limited to verified features, platforms, and release state.
